sources.title: qqceqqq/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains our TI2V-5B model, built with the advanced Wan2.2-VAE that achieves a compression ratio of 16×16×4. This model supports both text-to-video and image-to-video generation at 720P resolution with 24fps and can runs on single consumer-grade GPU such as the 4090.

sources.title: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo - GitHub
sources.snippet: Our model can generate 121-frame videos at 24 FPS with a resolution of 1280×704 in just 4 steps, eliminating the need for the CFG trick. To the best of our knowledge, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo is the first open-source repository of the distilled I2V version of Wan2.2-TI2V-5B.
